reviewMethod: All 17 selected stored files across the next five priority-eligible current-corpus papers were independently rehashed against the immutable read-only GitHub evidence artifact and checked for exact task/page/article/source DOI identity, original Figure/Scheme identity and independent caption, captureVersion 6.2.20, job identity, fixed media generation 1790082000000, content-addressed R2 key, actual byte length/type/dimensions, duplicate source/hash ownership, frozen public same-ID state and TOC separation. All 15 SVG files were parsed, rendered and checked for script, foreignObject, event-handler, javascript/external href and external CSS URL content; the two PNG files were decoded and dimension-checked. Every image was visually reviewed against its owning caption and article theme for body-image role, unrelated/recommendation contamination, duplicate risk and legibility. Capture success and partial/transport/format checkpoints were treated only as provenance evidence. No publisher request, R2/D1 write, direct import/repair, literature/card/title/scope mutation, userscript change or media-generation change was performed.
quality: The 17 files are exact stored bytes with matching full SHA256, sizes and dimensions. Selected full hashes and source URLs have no cross-DOI ownership collision in the frozen stage inventory. Partial article reports are handled per-image: ACS Catalysis 10.1021/acscatal.6c04954 remains 3/4, JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c15694 remains 3/5, Organic Letters 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03353 remains 1/4, and 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03382 remains 5/7, so only the exact reviewed stored files are approved and missing images are not inferred. 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03595 has a final 5/5 capture. Figure 1 files are body-only and are not TOC substitutions. Existing official TOCs for JACS/Organic Letters are distinct source/hash objects and remain untouched; the frozen evidence snapshot had no body same-ID collisions for this batch.
